name: slotlock_list_resources
title: List calendar resources
description: List resources visible to the authenticated tenant principal.

name: slotlock_get_free_busy
title: Get free-busy
description: Return privacy-minimized busy intervals and explicit coverage certainty.

name: slotlock_find_next_available
title: Find next available interval
description: Find the earliest certain interval that satisfies the requested duration (up to the 367-day search window, so a multi-month rental slot can be found).

name: slotlock_find_available_slots
title: Find available slots
description: List up to `limit` certain slots of the requested duration, earliest first across the resources, each one free of busy time and inside the resource's hours, to offer a person a choice. With require_free, only times when at least that many of the resources are free together, each slot naming them in resource_ids: every resource for a booking that needs them all (book it with slotlock_book_together), or any n of them. No slot is listed unless every resource's coverage is certain.

name: slotlock_create_event
title: Create resource event
description: Create an event of up to 3,660 days (a booking, lease or long rental); opaque occurrences use the database overlap arbiter.

name: slotlock_book_together
title: Book resources together
description: Book the same time on 2-20 resources at once, all or none: a van with its driver, a room with its projector. If any of them is taken, nothing is booked, and the refusal names that resource_id. Find such a time with slotlock_find_available_slots and require_free. A retry with the same idempotency_key answers the same events.

name: slotlock_get_event
title: Get resource event
description: Read one tenant-scoped event by stable identifier.

name: slotlock_list_events
title: List resource events
description: List bounded events intersecting a time window.

name: slotlock_update_event
title: Update resource event
description: Apply an expected-revision event patch and rematerialize occupancy atomically. With expected_resource_id, the resource you read the event on, an event since moved elsewhere is not found.

name: slotlock_delete_event
title: Delete resource event
description: Tombstone an event at an expected revision so stale sync cannot resurrect it.

name: slotlock_hold_slots
title: Hold candidate slots
description: Hold up to five candidate slots for a short time (30-900 seconds) while a person chooses, as alternatives in one group: each free one is held, the others are listed with why not. Book one by passing its hold_id to slotlock_create_event, which releases the rest; unbooked holds expire on their own. A hold is yours alone, and you may have 20 live at once.

name: slotlock_release_slots
title: Release held slots
description: Release one of your holds, and the rest of its group, at once instead of letting them expire. `released` is false when it was already gone.
